licence.terms: "Also note that music, scientific papers, code, and text other than press releases, announcements, images of the week and captions on this site are not released under the" "can not be used for non-NOIRLab products."
licence.scope: NOIRLab outreach-site copyright page (step 3); same statement and class as sibling WIYN/ODI. It says scientific papers, code and other text are not under CC BY 4.0; it does not mention the curve files and no filter page grants terms. Page SVO cites: https://noirlab.edu/science/filters (fetched, HTTP 200, no licence statement). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

notes: DetectorType of UliqTek_2a, UliqTek_2b, Uliq_1, UliqTek_3, Ca_2, BHarris_1, gSDSS_1, MWash_0, DDO51_0 set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: CTIO publishes this curve as its own percent-transmission scan of the filter alone (e.g. 'C.T.I.O Filters 3530-280 u Strömgren … R. Gonzalez June 1994', columns 'Wl. %'; https://noirlab.edu/science/programs/ctio/filters/3x3-inch-and-4x4-inch-filters and the archived www.ctio.noao.edu/instruments/filters/FILTER-CURVES/). These 3x3- and 4x4-inch filters are the CTIO 0.9-m's, whose imager Tek2K 'is a 2K optical CCD imager'. NOIRLab's Hydra filter list, the source of the WIYN/Hydra copies, serves the WIYN Bench Spectrograph, also read by a CCD (https://www.wiyn.org/Instruments/wiynbench.html). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
